scenes.caption: A little worm.
scenes.say: This is Zara's sticky-tack worm. It is four blobs long.

scenes.caption: Ten times longer.
scenes.say: Zara makes the worm ten times longer. How many blobs now?

scenes.caption: Forty blobs.
scenes.say: Four tens is forty blobs. The four moves into the tens column.

scenes.caption: Ten times bigger.
scenes.say: Each blob is now a ten. Ten times bigger, one place to the left.

scenes.caption: Back to four.
scenes.say: Now divide by ten. The digits move one place to the right again.

scenes.caption: Zara says shukriya!
scenes.say: Forty divided by ten is four. Shukriya, Zara!
